name: Craig MacAlpine
story: Craig MacAlpine of the New Zealand Fire Service presented a 2017 conference lightning talk on drone imagery capture and processing. The presentation records UAV imagery entering operational emergency-service GIS at the same time that drones were becoming routine spatial data-capture tools.
